studio_description: Describe an image or video to generate it. Publish the ones you like to the gallery.
studio_prompt_placeholder_image: Describe the picture, e.g. a cabin in the mountains at dawn, light mist, soft light
studio_prompt_placeholder_video: Describe the scene and camera, e.g. mist slowly clears over a lake as the camera pushes in
studio_model_unsupported: This model's parameters are not supported yet. Choose another model.
studio_no_models_image: Your plan has no image models available.
studio_no_models_video: Your plan has no video models available.
studio_reference_missing: Choose or upload a reference image first.
studio_reference_invalid: The reference must be an image file.
studio_estimate_suffix: credits, not charged if it fails
studio_estimate_unavailable: Complete the parameters to see the estimated cost
studio_insufficient: Not enough credits: this needs {cost}, you have {balance}.
studio_error_upgrade: Your plan can't use this model.
studio_error_quota: Storage is full. Remove some files and try again.
studio_error_busy: Too many tasks are running. Try again shortly.
studio_error_poll: Can't load progress right now. Retrying.
studio_readonly: You have read-only access to this workspace and can't create or publish.
studio_empty_body: Describe what you want and press Generate. Results appear here and are saved to My works.
studio_running: Generating, usually 10–30 seconds. You can leave this page; the result is saved to My works.
studio_failed_body: Reserved credits were returned under the usual rules. Adjust the prompt or parameters and generate again.
studio_cancel_unstarted: The provider has not started generating. Canceling returns all reserved credits and does not use your free cancellation.
studio_cancel_free_started: The provider has already started generating. Each workspace gets one free cancellation of a started task; this cancellation uses it and returns all reserved credits.
studio_cancel_charged: The provider has already started and this workspace has used its free cancellation. Canceling charges the full price of {credits} credits.
studio_publish_description: Published works appear in the gallery right away and are indexed by search engines after review. You can unpublish at any time.
studio_publish_description_short: Published works appear in the gallery right away and are indexed after review.
studio_publish_title_hint: Up to {max} characters, shown on the work page and share card.
studio_publish_show_prompt_hint: Visitors can see it and use it to make their own.
studio_publish_show_prompt_hint_short: Visitors can use it to make their own.
studio_publish_limit_error: You've reached today's limit of {limit} publications. It resets at {time}.
studio_publish_limit_error_plain: You've used today's publications. Try again tomorrow.
studio_publish_removed: An admin removed this work, so it can't be published again.
studio_published: Published to the gallery. It will be indexed after review.
studio_unpublished: Unpublished. The public address no longer works.
studio_works_description: Images and videos generated in this workspace. Published works appear in the public gallery.
studio_works_readonly: You have read-only access to this workspace. You can view works but not publish, unpublish, or delete them.
studio_works_empty_body: Images and videos you generate appear here automatically.
studio_works_empty_filtered_body: Try other filters, or create something new.
studio_delete_description: The file will be deleted and any public work page or share link stops working immediately. This can't be undone.
